failure_patterns_with_evidence: The lowest validation F1 was for roses. The largest confusions were dandelion to daisy (7 images); roses to tulips (7 images); tulips to roses (5 images). In the AI-assisted review of 20 incorrect cases, 6 were tagged as similar-looking classes, 5 as clutter, and 3 as small or distant flowers. Some heatmaps highlighted surrounding objects rather than the flower. These observations suggest possible failure patterns but do not prove their causes.
one_proposed_fix_and_reason: Test stronger training scale augmentation by changing RandomResizedCrop from scale=(0.75, 1.0) to scale=(0.5, 1.0). This may improve recognition across flower sizes. Smaller crops can also exclude the flower, so this is a hypothesis to test. Keep all other settings and the original splits fixed, and compare validation macro-F1 before final test evaluation.
limitations: One split and seed; errors selected partly by confidence; review combines user and AI-assisted visual observations; Grad-CAM is approximate and independently normalized; softmax scores are uncalibrated; no test metrics yet.
